test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

CAKE - ACKE - EKAC

KING - IKNG - GNIK
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edbaab3f07fa7124eb8de039bf81e72fd6f4dc276b05afdf351afb84e79c158c.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

CAKE - ACKE - EKAC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1221a721315d430841d959b9edfdb3fbf108d5b4bb96dfb236826103f3e4dac8.png] 

KING - IKNG - GNIK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acbecf4613ed932b9c06b967819117f9fe567734fcb19af04c4db935c1d94899.png] 

Let’s check each option:

1. KEYS - KYES - SYEK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ac0c2991da349308f7d5d9bb1ce21c64bdace3bef3549d14c5d2ea07747b0ab.png] 

This option does not follow the same logic.

2. ROAD - ORAD - OADR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0a6e671cbc4036afa2b91bc2631ad3157070f08e647a5f58d2d54886a9f4fac.png] 

This option does not follow the same logic.

3. POST - OPST - TSOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30d5ffd3f04137e8bae8ea1ba9f875028c9d89975b08d7ef215cdd624fe3c1b9.png] 

This option follows the same logic.

4. MUTE - UMTE - EUTM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a03c57089615673f7d32958179b27125e9f6685b3951439a7a6620c2a73317e.png] 

This option does not follow the same logic.

Thus, POST - OPST - TSOP follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
